theses.subject: Consumer Staples & Retail
theses.thesis: XST.TO is the only trend-eligible theme with full breadth (1.0) and a persistent trend tag, suggesting durable participation; it is crowded (z=1.02), which is a size-down caution but not a fade.
theses.dissent: Crowded trends can reverse sharply; the high crowding flag paired with a rank-IC ~0 momentum signal means this may already be fully owned.

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: ZEB.TO is trend-eligible with solid breadth (0.714) and durability (0.70), ranking second on momentum; the rotation challenger read suggests leadership is broadening beyond energy.
theses.dissent: Rising rates or credit stress could hit bank margins and loan books; momentum rank has no forward edge on its own.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO laggs the S&P/TSX by 3% while Utilities & Renewables makes a new 20-day high before the check-by date

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: XUT.TO is trend-eligible with high breadth (0.917) and the best non-crowded durability (0.81); its trend tag and negative crowding z (-0.27) make it a cleaner trend candidate than crowded staples.
theses.dissent: Rising yields pressure utility valuations; if rate-sensitive defensives rotate out, trend persistence may fail despite breadth.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO gives back all its 20-day gain while the TSX is flat over 10 sessions before the check-by date
